body:
Several more today, seems to be related to the recently introduced sub searches:

https://gradle-enterprise.elastic.co/s/yzc7b75za3nom

```
java.lang.AssertionError: Failure at [search.vectors/40_knn_search:126]: expected [2xx] status code but api [search] returned [400 Bad Request] [{"error":{"root_cause":[{"type":"illegal_argument_exception","reason":"cannot serialize [sub_searches] to version [8070199]","stack_trace":"org.elasticsearch.ElasticsearchException$1: cannot serialize [sub_searches] to version [8070199]\n\tat org.elasticsearch.server@8.10.0-
```

assigning to jack. It has to do with BWC serialization of sub-searches. My guess is that the code is doing a check where `sub_searches > 2` to an "OLD node" and is automatically saying its not supported. However, it is indeed supported if one of sub-searches is a KNN one.

issue.title: Fix `sub_searches` serialization bug

labels.name: test-full-bwc
labels.description: Trigger full BWC version matrix tests

repository.name: elasticsearch
repository.description: Free and Open Source, Distributed, RESTful Search Engine

issue.body:
We have allowed hybrid search since 8.4. This means the internal changes for `sub_searches` must be able to write a compound query as early as 8.4, but currently we only do that back to 8.8. This change fixes that issue.

Closes #https://github.com/elastic/elasticsearch/issues/97144
